name: Girl Frame
detailed_description:
When the stars become hunting grounds, do you choose to sink into desire or tear apart the darkness?

A sci-fi action game that combines roguelike survival shooting and mecha cultivation, with a "vampire survivor"-like fast-paced battle as the core, bringing an adrenaline-pumping interstellar survival experience.

Protagonist team setting:

In this chaotic interstellar, a team of interstellar pirates and smugglers quietly descended. They are adventurers driven by the temptation of rare resources. The team members have their own characteristics, including mecha experts, combat experts and spaceship experts. Faced with the threat of the ancient gods, they must not only survive in this interstellar, but also fight against the manipulation of the ancient gods and rescue the controlled beautiful girl combat mecha pilots.

Gameplay highlights:

Survival game in the eternal night: In the ruins of the mysterious galaxy, control the war mecha to fight against the tide of distorted creatures;

The eternal choice of fall and redemption: rescue the mecha girl who is controlled by the mind, and unlock the combined ultimate move through "neural synchronization";

Deep space base construction: collect resources, upgrade the mothership technology tree, unlock the mecha invisible force field/driver gene modification warehouse;

Mecha, skills and weapons: choose different mechas, weapons and drivers according to your own fighting style. Do you activate the energy shield to play steadily, or stack the rampage module to become a battlefield meat grinder? Your tactical DNA will define the destruction of the entire galaxy!

Visual impact: Witness the distorted body that merges mechanical and biological tissues, presenting alternative horror under dynamic light and shadow;

Join this galactic gamble-on the edge of madness and reason, rewrite the final equation for the survival of civilization!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 or Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 or Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
